controllerType: EC4 (LCD panel, blue, with voice navigation and IoT connectivity)
type: C4 Internet overlock sewing machine (包缝机)
note: EC4 controller V3.16 (2020-08-05). Features 3-sensor system (front/rear/anti-cut cloth), IoT connectivity, voice navigation in 10 languages, and three sewing modes (full automatic / semi-automatic / full manual). P94 selects model variant: electric (chopper), pneumatic, or side draught. Note: some default values differ between chopper (砍刀) and side draught (侧吸) variants.

specs.panelKeys: P | Left (◄) / Language | Up (+) / Speed+ | Down (-) / Speed- | Right (►) / LED | Sewing mode | Presser foot lifter | Trimmer parameter | Reset | Voice navigation
specs.sewingModes: Full automatic (全智能) / Semi-automatic (半智能) / Full manual (全电脑)
specs.presserFootModes: Front lifter / Rear lifter / Front+rear lifter / Closed
specs.sensorSystem: Three sensors: front sensor, rear sensor, anti-cut cloth sensor
specs.voiceLanguages: Chinese, English, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Portuguese, Spanish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Polish
specs.iotCapability: IoT piece count (M6) and IoT working status (M11) monitoring
specs.technicianParameterAccess: Press P + presser foot lifter button together for 1.5 seconds (shows P26)
specs.systemMemberAccess: Press P + Up button, enter 3-digit password '111'
specs.factoryResetMethod: Press Reset button for 1.5s (restores user saved params); press Left + Right together for 1.5s (restores full factory defaults + associated params)
specs.sensorCalibration: Press P + Voice button together for 1.5 seconds to start sensor auto calibration

errorCodes.cause: Motor stall — machine head stuck or difficult to turn; motor plug or sensor connector loose
errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or difficult to turn. Check motor plug and motor sensor connector for looseness or fall-off. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Software overcurrent — voltage abnormal or motor load excessive
errorCodes.solution: Check if the voltage used is normal. Try to restore factory settings or restart power supply. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Operation panel and control box communicate abnormally — cable loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power; check if motor Hall signal connector is loose or disconnected; return to normal and restart. Try restoring factory settings. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.
errorCodes.voiceBroadcast: Operation panel and controller box communication is abnormal

errorCodes.cause: Motor Hall error — Hall signal connector loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power; check if motor Hall signal connector is loose or disconnected; return to normal and restart. Try restoring factory settings. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal needle stop signal — motor stop signal connector loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Turn off system power; check if motor stop signal connector is loose or fallen off; return to normal and restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Presser foot protection — presser foot not returned to correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check if presser foot is pushed back to correct position. If still cannot solve, temporarily change P57 parameter from 1 to 0. If still cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.
errorCodes.note: After placing presser foot in correct position, press P key to clear E06 error

errorCodes.cause: Slot (sewing table) protection — sewing table not pushed to correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check if sewing table is pushed to correct position. Temporarily change P58 parameter from 1 to 0. If still cannot resolve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Needle bar shield protection — needle bar guard not in correct position
errorCodes.solution: Check that needle bar guard is placed back in correct position. Temporarily change P59 parameter from 1 to 0. If still cannot resolve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal foot pedal connection — pedal plug not connected to control box
errorCodes.solution: Check if pedal plug is connected to control box. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Hardware overcurrent — power supply voltage abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try to restore factory settings or restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Overpressure during shutdown — power supply voltage abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try to restore factory settings or restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: System undervoltage — power supply voltage too low
errorCodes.solution: Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try to restore factory settings or restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal brake circuit — brake circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Parameter read and write exception — memory fault
errorCodes.solution: Try to turn off power and restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overspeed protection (not available currently)
errorCodes.solution: Try to turn off power and restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Motor reversal (not available currently)
errorCodes.solution: Restore factory settings. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Overvoltage during operation (not available currently)
errorCodes.solution: Check power supply voltage. Try restoring factory settings or restart.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overload (not available currently) — machine head stuck or motor plug loose
errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or difficult to turn. Check if motor plug is loose. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Current detection loop abnormal — circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Try to turn off power and restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Power off — abnormal power disconnection
errorCodes.solution: Check power connection and restore power normally.

errorCodes.cause: Voice chip works abnormally — voice system fault
errorCodes.solution: Try to restore factory settings or restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Adapter board communicates abnormally with controller — connection loose
errorCodes.solution: Check if connection between adapter plate and control box is loose. Try restoring factory settings or restart. If cannot solve, contact local service or call 4008876858.

errorCodes.cause: Factory reset error — factory settings restoration failed
errorCodes.solution: Shutdown and restart; restore factory settings again.

errorCodes.cause: Trimming electromagnet error — trimming solenoid fault
errorCodes.solution: Check trimming electromagnet connection and function. Contact local service if needed.

errorCodes.cause: Lifting foot electromagnet error — presser foot solenoid fault
errorCodes.solution: Check lifting foot electromagnet connection and function. Contact local service if needed.

errorCodes.cause: Counting counts in ascending order — count full (upper limit reached)
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear, or set P71 parameter to 5.

errorCodes.cause: Counting counts in descending order — count full (reached zero)
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear, or set P71 parameter to 5.

alarmCodes.solution: Check if front sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces are clean.
Check if mid-sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces are clean.
Check if rear sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces are clean.
Check all three sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces are clean.

alarmCodes.meaning: Fabric recognition sensitivity error — fabric is too thin
alarmCodes.solution: The fabric is too thin. Try fabric identification again.

alarmCodes.meaning: Cloth warning during identification process — cloth on table during recognition
alarmCodes.solution: Remove cloth from table and test again.

alarmCodes.meaning: Panel and electronic control models do not match — firmware mismatch
alarmCodes.solution: Upgrade electronic control and panel programs to matching programs.

troubleshooting.symptom: E6 presser foot protection alarm that won't clear
checks: Place presser foot back in the correct home position
After placing presser foot in correct position, press P key to clear E06 error
If presser foot safety switch is faulty, temporarily set P57 from 1 to 0 to disable protection
Contact local service or call 4008876858 if persistent

troubleshooting.symptom: Sensor calibration fails (A-01, A-02, A-03, A-04)
checks: Clean front, mid, and rear sensor receiver and transmitter surfaces
Press P + Voice button for 1.5 seconds to restart sensor auto calibration
If A-05 (fabric too thin) appears, use thin cloth mode: long press LED button 1s, switch to mesh fabric type A

troubleshooting.symptom: Thread cutting quality poor (too long or too short)
checks: Adjust P27 (delay stitches before sewing trimmer) — bigger value makes thread shorter
Adjust P28 (anti-cut cloth sensor delay stitches) — smaller value makes thread on cloth shorter
Check P7 (auto trimming setting) — ensure front and rear trimming are configured correctly
Check anti-cut cloth sensor (P32) and sensor sensitivity (P33)

troubleshooting.symptom: Machine not detecting fabric in automatic mode
checks: Check P22 (front sensor) and P25 (rear sensor) are set to 1 (on)
Check P5 (sewing mode) — must be 1 (semi-auto) or 2 (full auto) for sensor detection
Clean sensor surfaces and run auto calibration (P + Voice key for 1.5s)
In automatic mode: before needle number that front sensor sets is done, middle sensor must be triggered
